name: Krannert Building
source_scope: Krannert source asset, dedicated builder, and building-specific audit only. Master, marker, manifest, README, shared indexes and other building assets were not edited.
changes_since_round3: Applied a qualitative warm limestone/precast material variation and charcoal glazing to the existing facade materials.

Recolored 454 ground-to-L1 wall faces with an estimated red-brown masonry material. Replaced direction-sensitive brick/mortar patterning with restrained nondirectional color and bump variation because the undated photo does not resolve coursing or module scale.
No facade openings, roof, footprint, floor elevations, canopy, or courtyard/re-entrant seam geometry changed. The R3 unsupported surrounding plaza slab remains absent.
Rendered a broad-facade/return comparison and two oblique re-entrant views from the reopened source using temporary cameras and render-only ground.

visual_sources.title: Krannert Building exterior photograph
visual_sources.limits: Perspective photograph, not a measured elevation or source for exact material values, dimensions, facade-opening geometry, roof form, or hidden/courtyard elevations.

visual_sources.title: Krannert Building construction aerial
visual_sources.limits: Construction-era aerial does not establish current roof equipment, exact roof elevations, current facade, or as-built condition. No roof changes were made.

gis_and_master_registration.feature_source: Purdue Campus GIS BuildingShapesZip4 FeatureServer layer 0, FID 54; details and metadata in evidence_round3.json and krannert_geometry_review_r3.json.
gis_and_master_registration.limits: The wire was derived from the same feature; it is construction alignment, not independent as-built confirmation. Coordinate conversion is approximate; wall AABB is a screening check rather than polygon-shape verification.
gis_and_master_registration.marker_scope_limit: Read-only coordinator check establishes marker/manifest value agreement only, not shell-to-GIS polygon registration, facade accuracy, or vertical datum. This source task did not edit the master or marker.

unknown_or_approximate_dimensions: GIS attributes R=117 and Extrution=108 have no descriptions or units in returned layer schema; model roof/penthouse elevations remain unverified estimates.
The 1963 aerial supports only broad flat-roof/multi-wing context; current mechanical penthouse/equipment detail and top elevations are not verified.
The courtyard/re-entrant seam remains unresolved. The round4 two-view image shows model geometry from two directions, not source-supported seam validation.
Interior room XY positions, dimensions, furniture counts and circulation remain estimates; available plans are not to scale or not registered.
independent_review_status: Awaiting a fresh independent full-building grade; builder assigns no self-score.
integration_note_for_coordinator: Master placement review counted 671 objects in its linked source snapshot; the current source export collection has 670 objects because KRAN_Surrounding_Plaza_Paving was removed in R3. Shared manifest inventory still names that deleted object and requires coordinator-side reconciliation before/at integration.
